key_insight: Enhancing dynamic state features and reshaping rewards makes deep reinforcement learning flow control more effective across synthetic jet positions and Reynolds numbers.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive synthetic jet control can reduce drag, suppress lift and vortex shedding, and lower actuation energy consumption.
method: Train deep reinforcement learning controllers for multiple synthetic jet positions.
Enhance dynamic state features and reshape the reward function.
Evaluate control across Reynolds numbers from 100 to 400.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 8%–34% drag reduction with the optimized framework over Reynolds numbers of 100–400, alongside improvements in other control objectives.
watch_item: Performance beyond Reynolds numbers of 100–400 and transfer to physical flow-control hardware are not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Toward fully stabilized flow control using deep reinforcement learning
